Subject: MAP draft, owners & next steps — target close 10/31

Hi Jorge (and Ana),

Thanks again for the call earlier — great alignment on the integration scope. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with proposed milestones, owners, and dependencies. High level:

- Target close: 2026-10-31 (customer PO and signed SOW)
- Pilot commit (recommended): $50k for a 3-month pilot with usage credits to accelerate model validation
- Production commit ask (post-pilot): $150k ARR minimum to unlock preferred pricing and guaranteed capacity

Key milestones in the MP:
1) Pilot kickoff / sandbox access — owner: OptinAI (Ana) / Redwood on infra setup — target: 10/12
2) Benchmarking & perf/latency validation — owners: OptinAI Eng + Redwood Solutions — target: 10/19
3) Security sign-off (SSO + logging + limited data retention config) — owner: OptinAI SecOps — target: 10/22
4) Commercial signoff & PO — owner: OptinAI procurement — target: 10/31

Dependencies called out in the MAP: SOC 2 report availability (OptinAI requested limited evidence), procurement lead time, and internal legal review of our DPA (I attached a short summary of the clause we typically need).

Ask for you: Please review the attached MAP and confirm owners/dates where you want different names or timings. Also let me know which commercial path you prefer so we can route for the appropriate approvals:

A) 3-month pilot ($50k) + credits, then production commit discussion
B) Direct production commit ($150k ARR) for a discounted price & reserved capacity

If you pick B, we will need an exec-level approval for a pricing concession (discount / credits) depending on the final commit.

Attachments: OptinAI_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), OptinAI_usage_forecast_Q4.csv (your preliminary forecast), quote_draft_optinai_2026-10.pdf (example quote)

Thanks — I can update the MAP after you confirm owners and preferred commercial path.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 415-555-0198

Evelyn — thanks for the clear summary and fast turnaround. A few quick notes:

- We prefer option A to start (3-month pilot + credits). Internal execs want to see the benchmark results before a large ARR commit.
- Confirming Ana will own the sandbox steps; I will own procurement and legal coordination.
- For the security sign-off we need a short list of required artifacts from Redwood (SSO SAML metadata, retention config options, and audit log export cadence). Can you attach that?

Two small asks:
1) Can you put a line-item in the MAP that ties the benchmark pass criteria to the next commercial step (i.e., if latency < 120ms p95 and accuracy metrics pass, then we move to production quote)?
2) We will need a 30-45 day procurement window — can the target close shift to 11/15 if the pilot starts 10/12?

I'll review attachments and get back with any redlines.

—Jorge
